At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

And a line break.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.

At the beginning of August every year we hold a 3-day craft fair in St. Andrew’s Church, Penrith. The 2018 fair
will be the 7th. As well as local crafts we sell good quality second-hand books and bric-a-brac. All the
proceed from the sale of these, plus proceeds from refreshments, raffles and competitions – as well as a percentage of the craft sales - is divided between St. Andrew’s Church and a local charity. Last year, thanks to your generosity, we were able to donate over 6,000, and we want to beat last year's total!  This year we are supporting the Alzheimer’s Society.  This illness affects so many people’s lives.  Please help us to raise as much as we can.
If you can donate any good books or bric-a-brac, please let us know. We are happy to collect locally.  Thank you.
